ui.result.ok: Applied {requested}. Read back from the GPU: {readBack}.
ui.result.failedReadBack: Could not apply {requested}: {error} The GPU reports {readBack}.
ui.error.unhandled: Something went wrong (details in the log).
ui.error.gpuUnavailable: The NVIDIA GPU could not be read: {error}
ui.reset.detected: The GPU driver was restarted. Clock offsets and the VRAM lock return to their defaults after a driver reset.
ui.reset.nothingToReapply: The GPU driver was restarted and the settings went back to default. There is no startup or recent profile to reapply.
ui.reset.reapplied: The GPU driver was restarted. Profile "{name}" was reapplied:
ui.monitor.reasons: What is limiting the clocks now
ui.offset.title: Clock offsets
ui.offset.range: Driver range {min} to {max} MHz · now {current} MHz
ui.offset.unavailable: The driver does not report this offset.
ui.offset.note: Offsets go through the NVIDIA driver (NVML), apply to every P-state and are read back after applying. They return to 0 when the driver restarts. Raise them in small steps and test.
ui.vram.title: VRAM clock lock
ui.vram.selectLevel: Choose a memory clock level first.
ui.vram.status.auto: Automatic: the driver chooses the memory clock.
ui.vram.status.confirming: Lock requested. It is confirmed when the GPU is idle.
ui.vram.status.lost: The lock was lost (probably a driver reset). Turn it on again or enable automatic reapply in Settings.
ui.power.title: Power limit
ui.power.unknown: Checking whether this GPU allows changing the power limit…
ui.power.adjustable: This GPU allows changing the power limit through the driver.
ui.power.notSupported: This GPU does not allow changing the power limit through the NVIDIA driver (common on laptops). The limit is set by the laptop firmware; see the OEM tab.
ui.power.limits: In force {enforced} W · default {default} W · driver range {min} to {max} W
ui.budget.title: Whole-laptop power budget
ui.budget.enterAdapter: Type the wattage printed on the charger label to see how the power is shared.
ui.budget.noLimit: The GPU power limit could not be read.
ui.budget.split: GPU up to {gpu} W + CPU and the rest up to {rest} W = {adapter} W from the charger.
ui.budget.low: Little is left for the CPU: with CPU and GPU at full load together, the charger cannot keep up and the battery may drain while plugged in.
ui.budget.note: Estimate only: the laptop firmware decides the final split between CPU and GPU.
ui.tune.warning: Automatic tuning loads the GPU at 100% for several minutes while it raises the clock offset step by step. Unstable offsets can freeze games, crash the driver or, rarely, restart Windows. Save your work and close other programs first. Do not run it on battery.
ui.tune.maxHint: Leave empty to go up to the driver maximum.
ui.tune.vramTest: Check VRAM for errors at each memory step (recommended)
ui.tune.duration: Each memory step with the VRAM check can take 20 to 40 seconds.
ui.tune.acknowledge: I understand the risks and have saved my work.
ui.tune.result: Best offset {offset} MHz: score {best} {unit} against {baseline} at the start ({gain} %).
ui.tune.resultHint: Keep applies the best offset. Discard goes back to the offsets you had before the run.
ui.tune.error.step: The step must be a multiple of 15 between 15 and 1000 MHz.
ui.tune.error.max: The maximum offset must be a positive number, or empty.
ui.tune.error.seconds: Seconds per step must be between 3 and 120.
ui.tune.error.temp: The stop temperature must be between 60 and {max} °C.
ui.sessions.label: Label
ui.sessions.loadNote: Averages count only readings under load (GPU at 90% or more).
ui.sessions.exportNote: The export uses ';' between columns and ',' for decimals, so Excel with Brazilian settings opens it directly. The original file stays unchanged.
ui.profiles.title: Profiles
ui.profiles.empty: No profiles yet. Set the offsets and the VRAM lock, then save them here.
ui.profiles.resetHint: Sets both offsets to 0 and unlocks the VRAM clock. The power limit is not changed.
ui.profiles.saveTitle: Save the current GPU state as
ui.profiles.saveNote: The profile is read from the GPU (offsets, VRAM lock and, when adjustable, the power limit).
ui.profiles.overwrite: A profile named "{name}" already exists. Replace it?
ui.profiles.startWithWindows: Apply the startup profile when I sign in to Windows
ui.profiles.startupNote: Creates a Task Scheduler task that runs Unlock GPU silently (with administrator rights) 30 seconds after sign-in and applies the profile. No window opens.
ui.profiles.startupOn: Unlock GPU will apply "{name}" when you sign in to Windows.
ui.profiles.startupOff: Unlock GPU will no longer run when Windows starts.
ui.backup.title: Backup
ui.backup.note: The backup ZIP holds the settings, every profile and a snapshot of the current GPU state. Importing restores settings and profiles only; nothing is applied to the GPU.
ui.backup.confirmImport: Importing replaces the current settings and profiles with the ones in the backup. Continue?
ui.backup.imported: Backup imported. Nothing was applied to the GPU.
ui.oem.title: Laptop firmware (OEM)
ui.oem.valuesTitle: Power settings in the embedded controller
ui.oem.writesLater: These values live in the embedded controller's memory and may reset after a full power cycle; apply them again if they revert.
ui.settings.accentInvalid: Type a colour as #RRGGBB, for example #BAF568.
ui.settings.reapply: Reapply the profile after a driver reset
ui.settings.reapplyNote: Uses the startup profile, or the last profile you applied. A driver reset puts offsets and the VRAM lock back to default.
